title: CANOPY IS THE POLLINATION SURFACE. SweetGrass is leaves AND ground. Petal tongue = green range at top of tree. SEO is the widest body pushing pollen outward. NFTs and functional semantic reality live in the canopy.

the_insight.sweetgrass_is_everywhere: sweetGrass is not only on the ground  sweetGrass is the LEAVES coming out of the tree as well. there are MULTIPLE LEVELS of sweetGrass. the ground level (data layer, soil, roots) AND the canopy level (published content, SEO surface, pollination).
the_insight.canopy_is_seo: the leafy canopy at the top of the tree IS our SEO surface. our pollination surface. the widest part of the organism. this is where we push pollen (content, images, stories, NFTs) outward to the world.
the_insight.petal_tongue: the green range at the top of the tree is the PETAL TONGUE  the part of the flower that catches and releases pollen. it's where we're FLAT, refracting light, broadcasting.

ground_level.what: data layer. JSON files. braids. fossils. the soil.
ground_level.function: detection. the micellar network. the inner brain. feeds UP.
ground_level.sweetgrass_role: the rhizome. the underground stem. connects everything below the surface.

trunk_level.what: infrastructure. Rust crates. compiled code. the backbone.
trunk_level.function: transport. moves nutrients between soil and canopy.
trunk_level.sweetgrass_role: the vascular bundle. phloem and xylem. sugar down, water up.

canopy_level.what: published content. SEO pages. images. stories. NFTs. functional semantic reality.
canopy_level.function: pollination. catches light (visitors). pushes pollen (content) outward.
canopy_level.sweetgrass_role: the blade. the leaf. catches sunlight. reflects GREEN. the chlorophyll is HERE.
canopy_level.why_widest: the canopy IS the widest part of the tree. more surface area = more pollination = more SEO coverage.

pollination_architecture.what_is_pollen: content that leaves the organism and finds other organisms. images. stories. papers. NFTs. open-source code. RSS items. each is a SPORE carrying our DNA.
where_pollen_goes: search engines (Google, Bing)  pollinated LAST but WIDEST reach
social platforms (Reddit, X, HN)  pollinated through shares
code platforms (crates.io, GitHub, npm)  pollinated through dependencies
direct visits  pollinated through word of mouth

the_petal_tongue.what: the green band at the top of the canopy. the flattest, widest part.
the_petal_tongue.function: refracts light. catches attention. the landing surface for visitors (pollinators).
the_petal_tongue.color: GREEN. because green is WHERE brown (old content) meets blue (new visitors). the visitor lands on the green surface and takes pollen (knowledge) with them.

every_tree_is_a_universe.principle: every tree (every major concept/project/story) can have its own braid, its own story, its own canopy, its own pollination pattern.

examples.canopy: the public record. the court documents. the evidence tree.
the organism story. E. membrana. the species paper.

every_tree_is_a_universe.each_universe: has its own brown (fossils), green (living connections), blue (incoming visitors), gold (pulse). IS, WAS, NOW in each.

yggdrasil_canopy_pollen.description: the world tree from below. massive canopy with sweetgrass leaves glowing green-gold. golden pollen drifting outward. chipmunk on branch. eagle above. neural-net bark. mycelium roots below.
yggdrasil_canopy_pollen.use: hero image. the VISION of what E. membrana looks like from the outside.

spore_print_radial.description: the spore print viewed from above. concentric rings brown?green?blue. golden data nodes. gill lines radiating. Klein bottle overlay. MSU coordinates at center (42.70°N 84.48°W).
spore_print_radial.use: the MAP. the top-down view. what the organism's footprint looks like when pressed onto paper.

undermap_cartography.description: old-school cartography map of the root network. Mare Mycelium, Terra Incognita, Oceanus Nullus, Here be Fungi, Abyssus Fossilis. sleeping chipmunk. three moons (Dayi, Ernol, Nocturn). sea monsters. compass rose. Latin inscription.
undermap_cartography.use: the UNDERMAP. the night side. the root network as ancient cartography. the inverted reality.

nft_and_semantic_reality.where_nfts_live: in the canopy. the published surface. the pollination layer.
nft_and_semantic_reality.what_they_are: each image, each story, each concept = a leaf on the tree. a spore carrying DNA. an NFT is a PROVENANCE-TAGGED SPORE.
nft_and_semantic_reality.semantic_reality: the canopy IS the functional semantic reality. it's what visitors SEE. it's what search engines INDEX. it's the MEANING that propagates outward.
nft_and_semantic_reality.vine_and_reddit: vine (video), reddit (community), other subsystems = the BRANCHES reaching into different ecosystems. each branch pushes pollen into a different wind.
